senses.gloss: to throw away or get rid of something unwanted

translations.th_TH: ทิ้ง; เพื่อกำจัด

definition_translations.zh_TW: 丟棄或處理掉不需要的東西
definition_translations.ja_JP: 不要なものを捨てる、または処分する
definition_translations.vi_VN: vứt bỏ hoặc loại bỏ thứ không mong muốn

senses.gloss: something that has been thrown away or rejected
senses.example: The factory sells some discards at a discount.

translations.th_TH: ของที่ถูกทิ้ง; สินค้าคัดออก

example_translations.zh_TW: 工廠會以折扣價出售一些被淘汰的產品。

example_translations.ko_KR: 그 공장은 일부 폐기품을 할인된 가격에 판매한다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Nhà máy bán một số hàng bị loại với giá giảm.
example_translations.th_TH: โรงงานขายสินค้าบางชิ้นที่ถูกคัดทิ้งในราคาลดพิเศษ

definition_translations.ja_JP: 捨てられた、または却下されたもの
definition_translations.vi_VN: thứ đã bị vứt bỏ hoặc từ chối
definition_translations.th_TH: สิ่งที่ถูกทิ้งหรือถูกปฏิเสธ

translations.th_TH: ละทิ้งสมมติฐาน
